_comment: What the Linux ZIP bundles and what it leaves to the system (RES-DIST-002, ADR-000218). tools/release/package.py reads it. A dependency that matches a 'system' family is never copied into the package; every other dependency is bundled. Patterns are shell globs on the library's file name (its DT_NEEDED entry).

system.reason: glibc and its dynamic loader belong to the system: a bundled copy cannot be combined with the system's loader, NSS modules or locale data. The package states the minimum glibc version instead.

Mesa's and other drivers load the system's libstdc++ into the same process; an older bundled copy would be used instead and break them. Every distribution that has the required glibc has a new enough libstdc++.
The OpenGL dispatch libraries (libglvnd) and the GPU driver stack are the system's: they must match the kernel driver and the hardware (Mesa, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel).

The X client libraries are shared with the OpenGL driver (GLX) in the same process and follow the X server's protocol extensions; the xcb utility libraries Qt needs (icccm, image, keysyms, render-util, cursor) are bundled.

packages.debian: libx11-6 libx11-xcb1 libxcb1 libxcb-glx0 libxcb-randr0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shape0 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-sync1 libxcb-xfixes0 libxcb-xinput0 libxcb-xkb1 libxext6 libxrender1 libsm6 libice6
packages.fedora: libX11 libX11-xcb libxcb libXext libXrender libSM libICE
packages.arch: libx11 libxcb libxext libxrender libsm libice

system.reason: The Wayland client libraries are shared with the compositor protocol and the GPU driver's EGL platform; they exist on every Wayland session. Without them Resonant uses X11 (XWayland).
fontconfig reads the system's configuration and caches, whose format follows the system's fontconfig, and FreeType is shared with it; the system's fonts are used.
ALSA's library loads its plugins (PulseAudio, PipeWire) and configuration from system paths that differ between distributions.
zlib and expat are part of every distribution's base system with a stable interface, and the system's fontconfig uses its own expat.

qtPlugins._comment: Chosen by name (not every plugin): the X11 and Wayland platforms with their OpenGL integrations, offscreen for the runtime check without a display, image formats used by the help and screenshots, SVG icons, and input methods. Not bundled: platform themes (GTK 3 would load the system's GTK and GLib), print support, SQL, TLS, network information, EGLFS, VNC, QML tooling.

python._comment: The interpreter the native module was built for, its standard library and the third-party packages Resonant uses (RES-DIST-008). Excluded: the test suite and test modules, Tk, the GPL-licensed readline and gdbm modules (and dbm's gdbm binding), pip's bundled wheels, the static library for embedding, Debian's site customization (a link to /etc) and its pip marker.

packages.purpose: field data as arrays (resonant results, resonant_api.read_field_slice)
the automation API's Python client and bridge (resonant_api)

forbidden._comment: Files that must never be in the package (development artifacts).
